as_told.title: Condon Committee wrote its conclusion before the study was finished

plain: The US Air Force, which ran Project Blue Book (its UFO study of the 1950s and 60s), paid the University of Colorado for an outside study of UFOs, led by the physicist Edward Condon. A former government official named Karl Nell says Condon, who had worked on the Manhattan Project (the wartime atomic bomb effort), wrote the study's conclusion before the study was finished and bragged about it. Nell's account is played again, almost word for word, in a second episode, this time without the bragging. The point is that the study's dismissal of UFOs may have been settled in advance.
